query:
SELECT league_id, category, COUNT(*) as cnt,
  MIN(FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoff_utc_ms/1000)) as earliest,
  MAX(FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoff_utc_ms/1000)) as latest
FROM matches
WHERE category = 'uefa'
GROUP BY league_id, category
ORDER BY league_id;
